title: Face drawing
what: Draws one part of the expression document as SVG: every path cut into the same run of cubic segments so any part morphs into another, its paints resolved, and the parts inside it clipped at its outline.

title: Face display
what: The full-screen display at /bmo-face/: signs in once, keeps the screen awake and full, shows the face of the moment, plays a briefing with its mouth, and offers the stop press.

title: Served document and build
what: Reads the document the server serves, again on every save announced, keeps the last one its own check passes, and reloads the page when the served screen build is not the one running.

title: Shown face
what: Which face shows at a moment: the briefing speaking, the emotion lingering after it ends, the asleep face after a long idle, or the face of BMO's presence, and when that will next change.

title: Display sign-in
what: Signs a display in once with a BMO account and a device name, keeps the device token in the browser's own storage, and forgets it when BMO refuses it.

title: Briefing sound and mouth
what: Plays a briefing's sound with the display's token and moves the mouth from it: the loudness smoothed and mapped onto the mouth stages from silence to full voice, or a silent pass over the decoded sound.

title: Listener stream
what: Holds BMO's listener stream open for the display: cutting it into frames, reading the briefings and presence it carries, keeping the cursor across reconnects, and retrying with a growing wait.
